propositions: reopen does not cascade to closed parents, allowing a closed parent to hold an open child, violating the invariant that a parent is never more closed than its children
the parent-first cascade mechanism exists only for open → in_progress transitions via _cascade_open_parent, not for closed → open transitions
the close guard prevents closing a parent with open children but does not prevent the inverse: reopening children of a closed parent
reopening a child in a multi-level closed ancestor chain reopens only that child, leaving all ancestors closed
the cascade decision reads parent status without holding the write lock, creating a TOCTOU race where a benign peer transition should be tolerated but currently aborts the child
